full_judgment: 8. Mr Md Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing on behalf of the appellant, submits that the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division failed to appreciate that the pre-emptor never asserted in Miscellaneous Case No. 18 of 2001 filed under Order IX, rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure that Mr Monwar Hossain Khan and Mr Abdul Munim, learned Advocates were no longer the Advocates of the pre-emptor and that no material was placed to show that the vokalatnama of the said Advocates was revoked after disposal of Miscellaneous case under Order IX, rule 13 of the Code of Procedure and the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division misdirected himself in holding that showing the order of the Court to the said learned Advocates was not proper communication of the order to the pre-emptor and in that view of the matter, the impugned judgment is bad in law.
